item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 从怀疑到信仰：OpenClaw 如何改变我的生活
item.description:
标签: #AI代理 #自动化 #生产力

摘要: ChatPRD创始人Claire Vo分享了她从OpenClaw怀疑者（曾因误删家庭日历而受挫）转变为忠实用户的历程，详细介绍了如何通过9个AI代理管理业务、播客和家庭生活，并提供了安装配置、风险防范及多代理协作的实用建议。

原标题: From skeptic to true believer: How OpenClaw changed my life | Claire Vo

Claire Vo is the host of our sister podcast, “How I AI,” a former product executive and engineer, and founder of an AI startup called ChatPRD. Claire now runs her business, podcast, and family life with the help of nine OpenClaw agents running on multiple Mac Minis and old laptops. In this episode, Claire shares her journey from OpenClaw skeptic (it deleted her family calendar the first time she tried it) to true believer, and gives a masterclass in using AI agents in real life.

Claire Vo 是我们姊妹播客 "How I AI" 的主持人，曾任产品高管和工程师，也是 AI 初创公司 ChatPRD 的创始人。Claire 现在借助运行在多台 Mac Mini 和旧笔记本电脑上的九个 OpenClaw 智能体（agents）来管理她的业务、播客和家庭生活。在本期节目中，Claire 分享了她从 OpenClaw 怀疑者（第一次试用时它就删除了她的家庭日历）到忠实信徒的转变历程，并传授了在现实生活中使用 AI 智能体的精通课程。

Listen on YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts

可在 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple Podcasts 收听。

We discuss:

本期讨论：

  • The exact step-by-step process to install and set up OpenClaw (it’s easier than you think)
  • How to avoid the biggest OpenClaw mistakes (don’t install it on your main computer)
  • Actual use cases that have changed Claire’s life (e.g. family scheduling, inbound sales, podcast prep, and course management)
  • Why multiple specialized agents beat one general-purpose agent
  • The security risks everyone worries about—and how to handle them
  • Browser limitations, memory issues, and practical workarounds

  • 安装和设置 OpenClaw 的确切分步流程（比你想象的更简单）
  • 如何避免最大的 OpenClaw 使用误区（不要把它安装在你的主电脑上）
  • 真正改变 Claire 生活的实际用例（例如家庭日程安排、Inbound 销售、播客准备和课程管理）
  • 为什么多个专业化智能体（specialized agents）优于一个通用型智能体（general-purpose agent）
  • 每个人都担心的安全风险——以及如何处理它们
  • 浏览器限制、内存问题和实用的解决方法

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Python 漏洞查询工具
item.description:
标签: #Python #漏洞查询 #安全工具

摘要: 作者基于 OSV.dev 的开放 API 开发了一款 HTML 工具，支持通过粘贴 pyproject.toml、requirements.txt 文件或 GitHub 仓库地址，快速检测 Python 项目中的已知安全漏洞。

原标题: Python Vulnerability Lookup

I learned that the OSV.dev open source vulnerability database has an open CORS JSON API so I had Claude Code build this HTML tool for pasting in a pyproject.toml or requirements.txt file (or name of a GitHub repo containing those) and seeing a list of all reported vulnerabilities from that API.

我了解到 OSV.dev（开源漏洞数据库）提供了一个开放的 CORS JSON API（跨域资源共享 JSON 接口），因此我让 Claude Code 构建了这款 HTML 工具，用于粘贴 pyproject.toml（Python 项目配置文件）或 requirements.txt（依赖文件）的内容（或包含这些文件的 GitHub 仓库名称），从而查看该 API 返回的所有已报告漏洞列表。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Pretext：高性能文本布局测算方案
item.description:
标签: #文本测量 #性能优化 #浏览器渲染

摘要: Pretext通过将文本测量分离为prepare()预缓存和layout()快速计算两个阶段，利用离屏canvas避免昂贵的DOM操作，实现了高性能的多行文本高度估算，为浏览器应用带来新的文本渲染可能。

原标题: Pretext

Pretext

Pretext solves the problem of calculating the height of a paragraph of line-wrapped textwithout touching the DOM. The usual way of doing this is to render the text and measure its dimensions, but this is extremely expensive. Pretext uses an array of clever tricks to make this much, much faster, which enables all sorts of new text rendering effects in browser applications.

Pretext 解决了在不触碰 DOM 的情况下计算一段换行文本（line-wrapped text）高度的问题。通常的做法是渲染文本并测量其尺寸，但这计算成本极高。Pretext 运用一系列巧妙的技巧大幅提升速度，从而能够在浏览器应用（browser applications）中实现各种全新的文本渲染效果。

Here'sone demothat shows the kind of things this makes possible:

以下是一个演示，展示了这项技术能够实现的效果：

The key to how this works is the way it separates calculations into a call to aprepare()function followed by multiple calls tolayout().

其工作原理的关键在于将计算分离为对 prepare() 函数的调用，以及随后对 layout() 函数的多次调用。

Theprepare()function splits the input text into segments (effectively words, but it can take things like soft hyphens and non-latin character sequences and emoji into account as well) and measures those using an off-screen canvas, then caches the results. This is comparatively expensive but only runs once.

prepare() 函数将输入文本分割为若干片段（实质上是单词，但也能处理软连字符（soft hyphens）、非拉丁字符序列和表情符号等），并使用离屏 canvas（off-screen canvas）进行测量，然后缓存结果。这一步骤相对昂贵，但仅执行一次。

Thelayout()function can then emulate the word-wrapping logic in browsers to figure out how many wrapped lines the text will occupy at a specified width and measure the overall height.

随后，layout() 函数可以模拟浏览器中的自动换行（word-wrapping）逻辑，计算出文本在指定宽度下将占据多少行，并测量整体高度。

Ihad Claudebuild methis interactive artifactto help me visually understand what's going on, based on a simplified version of Pretext itself.

我让 Claude 基于 Pretext 的简化版本构建了这个交互式工具（interactive artifact），帮助我直观地理解其内部机制。

The way this is tested is particularly impressive. The earlier testsrendered a full copy of the Great Gatsbyin multiple browsers to confirm that the estimated measurements were correct against a large volume of text. This was later joined bythe corpora/ folderusing the same technique against lengthy public domain documents in Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, and more.

其测试方式尤为令人印象深刻。早期测试在多个浏览器中渲染了完整的《了不起的盖茨比》（The Great Gatsby），以验证针对大量文本的估算测量是否准确。随后，corpora/ 文件夹也加入了测试，使用相同的技术对泰语、中文、韩语、日语、阿拉伯语等多种语言的冗长公共领域文档进行验证。
